summary: Tested new Nómina (payroll) module end-to-end per request. 5/6 requested test cases PASS. Only failure is that the payroll DETAIL page (route /nomina/[id]) does not exist, so after 'Generar Nómina' the app redirects to a 404 - the user cannot see the calculated detail (devengados, deducciones per employee, aportes empleador, etc). The payroll itself IS created correctly with correct Colombian calculations (Devengado $3.000.000, Deducciones $240.000 = 4% Salud + 4% Pensión, Neto $2.760.000, base $3M > 2 SMLV so no aux. transporte, base < 4 SMLV so no fondo solidaridad).

minor.issue: Uses .single() when selecting the current-month payroll; if there are 0 rows (common) Supabase returns a PGRST116 error (logged) that is silently discarded. Prefer .maybeSingle() to avoid noisy error logs.
Uses .single() to check for an existing payroll and ignores the error, but PGRST116 will be logged each call. Same fix: use .maybeSingle().

Payroll header totals update after inserting lines does not check the .error - if it fails silently the header row will remain with totals=0 while lines exist. Recommend awaiting response and inspecting error.

Auxilio de transporte is added to total_earnings (correct) but NOT excluded from the base for employer contributions (health_employer, pension_employer, arl, sena, icbf, caja). Actually current code uses ibc = salaryEarned + overtime + bonuses + commissions which correctly excludes aux. transporte, that is OK. However salaryEarned = baseSalary / divisor even if hire_date is inside the period, so partial-period pro-rating for new hires is not implemented.

ui_bugs.issue: After createPayroll succeeds, router.push(`/nomina/${result.id}`) navigates to /nomina/{uuid} which returns 404 - This page could not be found. The Eye/Ver button in payroll-list.tsx line 140 also navigates to the same non-existent route. There is NO /nomina/[id]/page.tsx file in the app router. Users can create payrolls but cannot view any detail (devengados, deducciones, aportes empleador per employee) after creation.

Card 'Nómina Pagada (Año)' and 'Costo Total (Año)' only aggregate payrolls with status='PAID'. Since new payrolls are DRAFT, the cards remain $0 until a payroll is approved and paid - which is currently impossible to verify since Aprobar/Marcar como pagada also depend on the (working) approvePayroll/markPayrollAsPaid server actions but the detail page is missing. Consider showing YTD across all states with breakdown.

integration_issues.issue: The create->redirect flow lands on 404 because the [id] dynamic route is missing. Also affects Eye button in list.

action_items: P0/CRITICAL: Create /app/src/app/(dashboard)/nomina/[id]/page.tsx that consumes getPayroll(id) and displays: header (period, type, status, totals), lines table (empleado, devengados: salario, aux. transporte, HE, bonos; deducciones: salud 4%, pension 4%, fondo solidaridad, retención; aportes empleador: salud 8.5%, pensión 12%, ARL, SENA 2%, ICBF 3%, Caja 4%). Also add Aprobar / Marcar como Pagada buttons on the detail page for a complete flow.

P2: In src/actions/nomina.ts replace both .single() calls that are followed by a null-check with .maybeSingle() to eliminate expected PGRST116 error noise in logs (getPayrollSummary line 523, createPayroll line 288).
P3: Consider showing YTD costo empleador even for DRAFT/APPROVED payrolls in the summary cards, not only PAID.
P3: Consider pro-rating salaryEarned by actual worked days when hire_date is inside the period (currently pays a full month even if hired mid-month).
critical_code_review_comments: src/actions/nomina.ts is 543 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline limit; consider splitting employees/payroll into two files.
getPayroll (line 240) is exported and returns joined data, but there is no page to consume it. Wire up UI or remove the action.

createPayroll performs schema-level rollback manually (delete payroll on line error). Consider using a Postgres RPC / transaction to make this atomic and avoid orphaned payroll headers on partial failure.

Payroll calculations correctly implement 2026 Colombian rules per the request (Salud 4%, Pensión 4%, Salud empleador 8.5%, Pensión empleador 12%, ARL by risk level, SENA 2%, ICBF 3%, Caja 4%, aux. transporte only if base <= 2 SMLV, fondo solidaridad only if base > 4 SMLV).

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 test cases PASS - only detail page is missing (404)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 test employee via UI: Juan Perez, CC 1234567890, Desarrollador, Indefinido, salario base $3.000.000, ARL Nivel 1. Created 1 test payroll: Julio 2026 Mensual (id 257d4f8e-b6cd-460d-8bac-cc16efdcecce) in DRAFT status with Devengado $3.000.000 / Deducciones $240.000 / Neto $2.760.000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Módulo Nómina básico funciona salvo por la falta del route /nomina/[id]/page.tsx. Ya existe 1 empleado (Juan Perez CC 1234567890) y 1 nómina en DRAFT (Julio 2026, id=257d4f8e-b6cd-460d-8bac-cc16efdcecce) en la BD Supabase. Los cálculos colombianos son correctos. Al re-testear después del fix, entrar a /nomina, clic en botón ojo (Ver detalle) del row de julio 2026 - debería mostrar detalle con líneas por empleado y aportes patronales; luego probar Aprobar y Marcar como Pagada.
rca of the issue: createPayroll returns the new payroll row and NuevaNominaPage does router.push(`/nomina/${result.id}`). The corresponding dynamic route /nomina/[id]/page.tsx was not created, so Next.js returns 404. The Eye action in payroll-list.tsx has the same bug. Fix: create /app/src/app/(dashboard)/nomina/[id]/page.tsx that calls getPayroll(params.id) and renders the detail.
